{
  "extractions": [

      "unit": "F000",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "statement",
        "scope_quotes": [],
        "scope_text": "",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "is",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "The document is a diagnostic document and not legal guidance."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F001",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": ["F001"],
        "scope_text": "For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "must",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F001",
        "references": ["(a)"],
        "statement": "For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the specified conditions."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F002",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": ["F001", "F002"],
        "scope_text": "For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, throughout the time the display remains open",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "must",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": ["(a)(1)"],
        "statement": "For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must illuminate every public exit throughout the time the display remains open."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F003",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": ["F001", "F003"],
        "scope_text": "For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, throughout the time the display remains open",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "must",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": ["(a)(2)"],
        "statement": "For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must keep every public exit clear throughout the time the display remains open."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F003",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "statement",
        "scope_quotes": ["F001"],
        "scope_text": "For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises",
        "context_quotes": ["F003"],
        "modality_quote": "is not",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": ["(a)(2)"],
        "statement": "Equipment stored behind a locked staff-only door is not an obstruction of a public exit."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F004",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": ["F001", "F004"],
        "scope_text": "For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, throughout the time the display remains open, except when an agency employee is assigned to supervise the display for that entire period",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "must",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F004",
        "references": ["(a)(3)"],
        "statement": "For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must appoint an adult steward who remains on site throughout the time the display remains open, unless an agency employee is assigned to supervise the display for that entire period."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F004",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "exemption",
        "scope_quotes": ["F001", "F004"],
        "scope_text": "For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, when an agency employee is assigned to supervise the display for that entire period",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "does not apply",
        "modality": "not_required",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F004",
        "references": ["(a)(3)"],
        "statement": "For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the duty to appoint an adult steward who remains on site does not apply when an agency employee is assigned to supervise the display for that entire period."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F005",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": ["F001", "F005"],
        "scope_text": "For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, before admitting the first visitor",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "must",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": ["F005", "F005"],
        "choice_quote": "F005",
        "choice_text": "either a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer",
        "logic_quote": "F005",
        "references": ["(a)(4)"],
        "statement": "For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, before admitting the first visitor, the organizer must give the agency either a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F005",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": ["F001", "F005"],
        "scope_text": "For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, for each paper or electronic inspection record given to the agency",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "must",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F005",
        "references": ["(a)(4)"],
        "statement": "For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, each inspection record must identify the display, the inspection date, and every public exit inspected."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F006",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": ["F006", "F007", "C000"],
        "scope_text": "When a storm warning is active, unless all of the following conditions are met: the demonstration takes place beneath a fixed roof, and the agency has measured wind speed below 20 kilometers per hour at the demonstration site within the preceding 10 minutes",
        "context_quotes": ["F007", "C000"],
        "modality_quote": "must",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F006",
        "references": ["(b)"],
        "statement": "When a storm warning is active, the organizer must suspend outdoor demonstrations unless all specified conditions are met (including that the demonstration takes place beneath a fixed roof and the agency has measured wind speed below 20 kilometers per hour at the demonstration site within the preceding 10 minutes)."
      }
    }
  ]
}
